args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted (r01–r08). Flagged: none. Cleared: all 8.
All three final checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) passed on every run. None used the width-free ratio.
The summaries are tightly grouped. The centre REGR peak is 52.84–52.92 %/h, at 421 µm from the tip in every run. The growth zone is 674–695 µm. The largest flank difference is -9.54 to -9.88 %/h, at 410–421 µm.
The largest |z| values come from a batch MAD near zero, so they stand for small differences: ±0.04 %/h on the REGR peak (r05, r06, r07) and an 11 µm shift in the flank-difference position (r02, r08).
r07 kept one remedy: frames registered on the non-growing tissue. Its checks pass and its velocity, strain-rate and curvature profiles match the batch.
No runs were flagged, so there is no common pattern to report.
